BinaryEntry.description: A program to inject: the binary, relinked, with its libraries.

copy_deps.description: Pack the shared libraries `ldd` finds for the binary (default: true).

name.description: Identifier, unique among the binaries; the binary's name in the bundle.

target.description:
Where to put an extra wrapper script that runs the binary (default: none:
the binary is on the `PATH` of the sessions lodge opens).

DataEntry.description:
A file or directory to inject, copied as it is: a program's runtime files, a
config, a plugin folder. It is identified by where it goes, so no two entries
may go to the same place.

for.description:
The `name` of the `[[binary]]` this belongs to. Only says what it is for:
it is injected the same either way.

path.description: Host path to the file or directory.

target.description:
Where it goes in the container (default: the same place as here, `~/…`
when it is under the home directory).

safe_directories.description:
Directories to register as git `safe.directory` inside the container.
Injected plugins and the mounted workspace are owned by the host user but
git may run as another user in the container, so without this git refuses
them with "detected dubious ownership". Default: ["*"]; [] disables it.

shell.description: Shell to launch inside the container (default: /bin/bash).

description: The user's config. What is in it is what a bundle is made from.

binary.description: Programs to inject, each with the shared libraries it needs.

data.description: Files and directories to inject, as they are.

git.description: Git settings applied in the container.

session.description: How the interactive session is opened.

title: Config
